Name: Visible measures must have a description
Description: Visible measures must have a business-friendly description.

Name: Visible tables should have a description
Description: Visible tables should have a description to support discoverability and governance.

Name: Measures must use display folders
Description: Measures should be organized in display folders.

Name: Display folders should start with a dot
Description: Display folders start with a dot (for example .Base) so they sort above the measures in the table.

Name: Key or ID columns must not summarize
Description: Columns ending in Key or ID should use SummarizeBy = None.

Name: Technical columns must be hidden
Description: Technical columns such as surrogate keys must be hidden.
Expression: (Name.ToLower().Contains("key") or Name.ToLower().StartsWith("pq_sk_") or Name.ToLower().StartsWith("sk_")) and not IsHidden and not Table.IsHidden

Name: Tables must not use fact prefix
Description: Tables must not use a fact prefix (naming conventions).

Name: Fact tables must end with *
Description: Fact tables have a plural business name and end with * (for example Sales*), so users see that the table is a fact table (naming conventions). A fact table is on the many side of a relationship and never on the one side. Technical tables starting with _ are left out.
Expression: not Name.StartsWith("_") and not Name.EndsWith("*") and UsedInRelationships.Any(FromTable.Name == current.Name) and not UsedInRelationships.Any(ToTable.Name == current.Name)

Name: Tables must not use dim prefix
Description: Tables must not use a dim prefix (naming conventions).

Name: Hidden unused columns should be reviewed
Description: Hidden columns not used in relationships, hierarchies, sort by, or DAX should be removed in Power Query instead of being loaded.

Name: Object names must not have leading or trailing spaces
Description: Tables, columns, measures and hierarchies must not have leading or trailing spaces in their names.
Scope: Table, CalculatedTable, Measure, DataColumn, CalculatedColumn, CalculatedTableColumn, Hierarchy

Name: Relationships must be single-direction
Description: Relationships filter in one direction, from the dimension to the fact. Bi-directional relationships need a documented exception.

Name: Relationships must not be many-to-many
Description: Replace many-to-many relationships with a proper dimension and one-to-many relationships. Exceptions must be documented.

Name: The model must have a marked date table
Description: The model has a Calendar table marked as date table, with a date key column.
Expression: Tables.Any(DataCategory == "Time" and Columns.Any(IsKey == true and DataType == "DateTime")) == false

Name: Auto date/time must be turned off
Description: Auto date/time creates a hidden date table per date column. Turn it off and use the Calendar table.

Name: Avoid decimal (floating point) data types
Description: Use whole number, or fixed decimal (currency) when four decimals are enough, instead of decimal (double).
